Projects

AI · Writing tool

Attune

Attune measures how well a piece of writing fits its intended reader. Users define the audience once, such as college admissions officers or a 9th-grade class, and Attune rates each paragraph green, yellow or red with targeted revision suggestions. It is available on the web, as a Chrome extension, and inside Google Docs and Microsoft Word.

AI · Architecture

Model to render

Design · Student club

CRII

The Cultural and Religious Inclusion Initiative builds understanding across faiths through visits to temples, churches, mosques and community spaces, paired with donations to the communities it learns from. As co-founder and graphic design lead, I directed the outreach campaigns that grew it into the second-largest club at my school.
